Mimi Roman, The Brooklyn Cowgirls
description: Join us for an evening with1950's Decca Recording Artist Mimi Roman, accompanied by The Brooklyn Cowgirls. The band starts the evening off with a set featuring songs by Mimi's contemporaries, including Gene Autry, Elvis Presley, Patsy Cline, The Everly Brothers. Mimi then joins the Cowgirls onstage to sing her hits. The live music will be preceded by a short documentary of Mimi's Stories and Memories and a curated exhibit of stage costumes, instruments and photos as a visual anchor of her musical legacy. Born Miriam Rothman in 1934 and raised in Brooklyn, Mimi Roman fell for country music by catching late-night clear-channel radio broadcasts from Del Rio and Nashville. A horse-riding prize at the Madison Square Garden rodeo led to a singing spot beside Gene Autry, an audition for Arthur Godfrey's Talent Scouts, and eventually a Decca Records contract cut in Nashville with session players like Chet Atkins and producer Owen Bradley. Billed as the Brooklyn Cowgirl, she toured and recorded through the mid-1950s and early '60s; as Mimi Roman in country, and as Kitty Ford on the pop side; before stepping back from the industry to build a life closer to home. Decades later, her recordings found a second life among rockabilly collectors, leading to the 2022 archival releases First of the Brooklyn Cowgirls and Pussycat on Sundazed Music. Monday October 12th, 6:30-9pm at Lucinda's, 169 Ave A, NYC Limited Tickets available at lucindasnyc.com Visit mimiroman.com for more information.

name: Margo Cilker and Lilly Hiatt (21 and Over)
VIRTUAL HALSTON LIVE with Julie Halston and Jackie Hoffman
description: VIRTUAL HALSTON LIVE RETURNS TO BIRDLAND FOR ONE NIGHT ONLY OCTOBER 12 AT 7PMFeaturing Special Guest Jackie Hoffman New York, NY The hit web series VIRTUAL HALSTON, created during the global pandemic by Julie Halston, Jim Caruso, and Ruby Locknar, returns to the stage for a special one-night-only live presentation at Birdland on Monday, October 12 at 7pm. Julie Halston brings her signature wit, theatrical storytelling, and backstage brilliance to this special evening, joined by celebrated actress, singer and comedian Jackie Hoffman. The program will feature Halstons trademark stories along with an entertaining and insightful conversation between the longtime friends and collaborators. Ms. Halston says, Jackie Hoffman is one of the funniest humans alive. Weve known each other forever, worked together a number of times, and love to dish, judge, and make each other laugh. We have ALL the stories, and I cant wait to sit down with her on the Birdland stage to discuss all things show biz and, of course, all ongoing medical issues! Hoffman Julie Halston most recently appeared in the Broadway revival of Thornton Wilders Our Town. Her Broadway credits include Tootsie, Hairspray, Gypsy, and Anything Goes. In 2021, she received the Isabelle Stevenson Tony Award for her advocacy on behalf of The Pulmonary Fibrosis Foundation. Halston is widely known for her portrayal of Bitsy Von Muffling on Sex and the City and And Just Like That, and her sold-out one-woman performances at Birdland have earned her multiple comedy honors and a devoted following.
